hypothesis: After the same stable transport policy initialization, doubling only goal_progress from 20 to 40 will improve success rate or final distance after an equal PPO fine-tuning budget.
initialization: Common pretrained transport actor and critic; fresh Adam for every condition and training seed. These are fine-tuning seeds, not independent from-scratch trainings.
checkpoint_selection: Final updated policy at the fixed sample budget; no initial or best-checkpoint fallback and no selection on final evaluation.
report_uncertainty: Mean and sample SD over three fine-tuning seeds; common evaluation layouts and pretrained weights; report all paired differences.
hardware_note: Both GPUs are RTX A6000. GPU 1 has an unrelated workload. Reported times cover additional training and validation, exclude pretraining, and are not Colab T4 benchmarks.
